text:
cass: seeing a small spike in fncall schema rejects in eu-north since 09:10 UTC. Top reject tag = INVALID_TOOL_SHAPE.
hiro: I'm getting the alert too. That cluster got the strict-validator at 09:00 (canary 7%).
morgan: Quick sample from console sampling (redacted):
```json
{
  \"tool\": \"product_meta\",
  \"payload\": {
    \"id\": \"p_99\",
    \"attrs\": []
  },
  \"rid\": \"r_z1\"
}
```
validator expects attrs to be an object map; legacy adapters sometimes return [] for empty attrs.
cass: ops, can you soft-validate the affected tenant shards while we patch adapters? We want to avoid customer 400s.
ops: Yep. Which tenant shards are noisy? I see t-300 and t-301 with the most rejects. Enabling soft-validate now for those shards and creating incident #6120.
hiro: I'll push a tiny coercion in the adapter shim to normalize []|null->{} before the validator call. Unit tests added. ETA ~10m to cut a patch.
morgan: Console/UX asks: add a permissioned \"raw_sample\" link on reject rows and a `reject_reason` column. Right now samples are masked so triage is slow. Also show `validator.mode` on the rollout page.
cass: And we should emit trace/span tags: validator.mode, validator.canary_pct, rollout.slice_id. That lets SRE correlate rejects to rollout state without manual cross-checks.
hiro: Agreed. Telemetry side: also add metric fncall.validator.rejects_total with labels (region, tenant, validator_mode). Put a small dashboard tile: rejects pct vs canary pct over last 60m.
morgan: For automation: proposal is a Console toggle `auto-fallback-on-validator-spike` with knobs: threshold_pct, window_minutes, cooldown_minutes, and per-tenant opt-out. Require audit-logging ON (interlock) to enable the toggle.
ops: We want that interlock. Auto-fallback can hide regressions and we need a mandatory audit reason and actor for any automated routing change. Also ensure fallback emits a routing.attribution label for billing.
billing-bot: note: if requests are routed to permissive variant due to fallback, tag them with billing.label = \"validator_fallback\" so cost attribution is clear.
hiro: Good call. We'll add routing tag and ensure quota buckets reflect the serving variant. Also add a lightweight \"preflight\" simulation button in Console that runs the coercion on a sample of recent payloads and shows how many would change shape.
cass: Nice. That helps decide whether to auto-fallback or just fix adapters. For now, once hiro's patch lands and we see rejects drop below 0.5% for 5m, ops can revert soft-validate.
ops: Soft-validate enabled for t-300/t-301. Watching error budget and latency. Incident #6120 created.
console-bot: deploybot: strict-validator canary enabled at 09:00 UTC (7% eu-north) by hiro
console-bot: opsbot: incident #6120 created \"fncall validator rejects spike - eu-north\" assigned to eng-platform
